Misfired Pistols are looted from Small Treasure Chests in Stormsong Valley.
Minions of Hogger are gnoll mobs summoned by Hogger in Elwynn Forest. Once Hogger reaches 50% health, three of these will spawn in.
__NOTOC__ Mire Terrors are elite wicker brutes roaming the Dreadmire in Nazmir.
Mirefin Gars are groupers located along the eastern coast as well as in the Writhing Mire in the Spires of Arak. Several of them are seen dead.

Mischevious Alementals are alementals found at the Brewfest Grounds during Brewfest in Dun Morogh and Durotar. They appear during the ale invasion event. To defeat them, throw an Alcohol-Free Brewfest Sampler at them.

The Minor Manifestation of Air was an air elemental located in the Thousand Needles. The elemental was located high up, on one of the pillars in the area that had a large stone with shamanistic carvings. The elemental could be seen with Sapta Sight, although it was not involved in any quests.

Mistell (or MT) happens when sending a chat message (tell) to the wrong person or group. Said in guild chat: "Yeah, my guild sucks and I'm thinking of leaving them." "YIKES, MT. I was talking about another guild".

Mistress Nagmara is succubus minion of Plugger Spazzring, found in Blackrock Depths. Nagmara works as a barmaid at the Grim Guzzler and is in love with Private Rocknot, one of the patrons. She is also present in the area after the Dark Iron clan formally pledged themselves to King Anduin.
Mists of Dawn is a part of tauren mythology. It is recorded in-game on a wall hanging in the Archdruid's tent in Thunder Bluff.
__NOTOC__ Mistina Steelshield was a dwarf quest giver located in the Great Forge in Ironforge.
Mist is a saber cat quest giver located in the northwestern corner of the Oracle Glade in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
__NOTOC__ Misplaced Servo Arm drops from various mobs in Naxxramas.

Mist's Edge is by far the longest stretch of coast in Darkshore, reaching all the way from near the Ruins of Auberdine in the south through Lor'danel to the region's northern tip. It is dominated by gloomy bays and gray beaches, often littered with huge carcasses of sea animals — which are part of some quests — and dotted with the wrecks of sunken ships. Murlocs are an ever-present threat, but even more common are the crabs which scuttle along the entire stretch of shore.
Mist Howler is a rare timber wolf found in northwestern Ashenvale.

Mistletoe is acquired by simply typing /kiss while targeting a Winter Reveler located in most inns during the Feast of Winter Veil. Winter Revelers will randomly give you a stack of five of Mistletoe, or a after typing /kiss. Only the Winter Revelers in the inns participate. You will also receive a debuff preventing you from getting another of these gifts for one hour. This hour is real-time, so you can switch characters and come back an hour later.

This quest requires you to take a document from Rokaro at Shadowprey Village in Desolace to Myranda the Hag at Sorrow Hill in the Western Plaguelands. : This quest used to be named "The Testament of Rexxar" and was given by Rexxar. Rexxar moved to Outland with The Burning Crusade, so this quest was given to a different NPC. Only the NPC and the quest name were changed.
This quest starts the Mission: The Murketh and Shaadraz Gateways quest chain.
This quest is part of the Through the Dark Portal (Horde) quest chain.
This quest is based on the item Eroded Leather Case, which is dropped by Tunnelers and Marauding Crust Bursters.
Mistresses of Doom are shivarra found in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Mistmantle Family Ring is provided for the quest Clawing at the Truth.
The Mist Veil's Lockbox is located in the wreckage of the Mist Veil in Darkshore.
Mistie Flitterdawn is a gnome located in Fizzcrank Airstrip in the Borean Tundra.
Mistress of the Coldwind is a harpy located in the Coldwind Heights in the Dragonblight.
The Missing Journal Pages are found scattered around the Thor Modan courtyard in Grizzly Hills. Combining eight pages with the Incomplete Journal will form Brann Bronzebeard's Journal.
Mistcaller Soo-gan is an elite gorloc quest giver located at in Sholazar Basin. He may be leader of the Mistwhisper tribe because he is the only named gorloc at Mistwhisper Refuge.
In order to be eligible for this quest, players are required to have been awarded the title .
.]] Mistress of Dementia are shivarra found in the Den of Mortal Delights in the Black Temple. They spawn an Image of Dementia.

Mistress of Pain is an elite shivarra mistress faithfully under the command of Lord Jaraxxus, appearing in the Trial of the Crusader raid. They enter the coliseum from nether portals Jaraxxus summons. In Trial of the Grand Crusader the mistresses will continue to appear as long as the portal is alive.

Mistcaller's Cave is a cave on the western side of Hrothgar's Landing. Mistcaller Yngvar has taken up residence here and from this cave he manipulates the mists to conceal the Kvaldir and the sea beasts they command.
The Missing Diplomat's Pauldrons drop from Glubtok in the Deadmines on heroic difficulty.

Missa Spekkies is a goblin that can be initially found within Bilgewater Port in Kezan. While there, she is willing to trade a Stack of Macaroons for a pair of Cool Shades for the quest The New You. She can later be found at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara, lounging about in a chair. She has apparently retired here after the destruction of Kezan, as she offers no services, nor does she offer any quests.
Mistresses of Woe are shivarra found in the Den of Mortal Delights in the Black Temple.

Mistlurkers, as their name implies, are creatures that lurk within the mists of Pandaria, and seem to be made of it. They make their first appearance with the World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria expansion. Normally mindless and predatory, the ones of the Townlong Sumprushes show signs of intelligence.
Miss Rose is a mushan located in the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Mist Incarnations are mistlurkers found in Paoquan Hollow in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Miss Fanny is a domesticated mushan owned by Pang Thunderfoot. She helps with daily tasks at the farms in the Thunderfoot Fields of the Valley of the Four Winds.

Mistfall Village can be found in southwestern Vale of Eternal Blossoms, below the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east, and across the river from the Setting Sun Garrison to the west. It is a part of Mistfall province, which includes the village, the Tu Shen Burial Ground, and the surrounding region south of the river.

Mister Chu is the bodyguard of Madam Goya. He was originally found accompanying her at the Black Market in the Veiled Stair and later relocated with the rest of the Black Market to the in , followed by the Underbelly in Dalaran and now in Backwater Beach in Zuldazar. He has a single scar between his eyes.
Mistfall Villagers are pandaren located at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Mist-Hopper Emergency Buoy is provided as an objective for On the Crab.

Mister Pinch is a level 5 battle pet found next to its tamer Analynn in Ashenvale.. It uses a unique model not seen used by any other pet, and sadly since it is an already tamed pet it cannot be caught.

The Mistborne Robe is a quest reward from The Point of No Return.

The Mist-Filled Spirit Lantern drops off the whale shark Evermaw circling the Timeless Isle as party loot. It can then be used to summon the Dread Ship Vazuvius by using it on the Cursed Gravestone on the north shore of the Misty Strand.

Mist-Covered Treasure Chests are found floating on clouds after interacting with the Gleaming Crane Statue before the broken bridge leading to the Ordon Sanctuary on the Firewalkers' Path of the Timeless Isle. Players may interact with the Gleaming Crane Statue as often as they like until they loot a single chest, at which point the statue disappears until the next week. Players can loot as many chests as possible until the slow fall buff wears off. They each contain a decent amount of Timeless Coins.
Misplaced Scrolls is found at beneath the bridge immediately south of Skettis in northern Spires of Arak. It contains roughly 30 Arakkoa Archaeology Fragment and maybe an Arakkoa Cipher.

Misplaced Scroll is found at just below the north end of the Terrace of Dawn in central Spires of Arak. The trailhead for the path leading up to the scroll starts at roughly and circles around the terrace counterclockwise. The scroll contains some Arakkoa Ciphers and some Arakkoa Archaeology Fragments.

Mist-Hopper Jr. is a small boat equipped with a harpoon gun, used by Captain "Soggy" Su-Dao and the player to battle Jiao off Soggy's Gamble in the Dread Wastes during The Mariner's Revenge. It is named after Soggy's old vessel, the Mist-Hopper.

The Mission Command Table is located on The Banshee's Wail in Dazar'alor for the Horde and on the Wind's Redemption in Boralus for the Alliance. .]] A mob (short for mobile) is a generic term for any non-player entity whose primary purpose is to be killed for experience, quest objective, or loot. The gaming term "mob" is not to be confused with its usual meaning in the English language, i.e. a large disorderly crowd or an organized gang of criminals. Mobs are also known as bad guys, beasts, enemies, monsters, non-player attackers, and opponents. The World of Warcraft-specific term for a mob is creep which was coined by Blizzard and first used in Warcraft III. This list shows you quest / mob difficulty colors, depending on your own level. * Gray mobs give no XP and full reputation * Gray players give no Honor points * Gray quests give reduced XP, but full reputation. See [http://www.wow-europe.com/en/info/basics/questbasics.html Quest Basics]. A quest's or mob's difficulty color is sometimes referred to as its "con". I.e., a gray-con mob or something that cons red. This is a holdover from MUDs/MUSHs/MUCKs where the standard command to determine difficulty was /con or /consider.
